item: Climate: OWID CO2 and Energy bulk CSV parser and consented fetch (A1/S2 row 2, fixtures only)
key_paths: src/stats/owid_climate.py; src/stats/fetch.py; tests/test_owid_climate_parser.py; configs/external_artifacts.yml; docs/SECURITY.md; src/static/net-hosts.js
summary: Pure parser projecting a curated, unit-stamped column subset of OWID's owid-co2-data.csv and owid-energy-data.csv into vintaged figures: blank/NA/NaN are gaps never zero, other non-finite or malformed cells refuse the row, aggregates (no ISO code) keep their name and are flagged, curated columns missing from the header are reported, duplicate area-year and bad years are refused, refusals counted exactly with a 100-entry sample. fetch_owid_dataset behind the kill switch with a body bound derived from the table shape; raw.githubusercontent.com (owid org only) joins the Climate series consent lane and SECURITY.md row; registry entry owid-climate-bulk-catalog. Fixtures only: the column set and units are from OWID's published codebook, not verified live. Not yet shipped: store wiring, the surface, per-series freshness, and NSIDC, GHCN-Daily, ONI and USGS.
